repos_data.description: Odoo. Open Source Apps To Grow Your Business.
ERP beyond your fridge - Grocy is a web-based self-hosted groceries & household management solution for your home

Dolibarr ERP CRM is a modern software package to manage your company or foundation's activity (contacts, suppliers, invoices, orders, stocks, agenda, accounting, ...). it's an open source Web application (written in PHP) designed for businesses of any sizes, foundations and freelancers.

Self-hosted MCP gateway and company brain for AI agents: connect Claude, ChatGPT and Copilot to your ERP, APIs, databases and file servers, with company memory, skills, knowledge graph, SSO/RBAC and audit. 691 connectors (SAP, Odoo, SQL…). Open source, EU cloud.
Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that enables AI assistants to securely interact with Odoo ERP systems through standardized resources and tools for data retrieval and manipulation.
Low-code database framework that fits your needs
INFATON MCP Server — 94 tools for 1C:Enterprise ERP via Model Context Protocol (JSON-RPC 2.0). Open source, MIT. infaton.ru · chatmcp.ru

Official MCP server for Frihet ERP — 157 tools for AI-powered invoicing, tax & e-invoicing compliance (VeriFactu, TicketBAI, Facturae), banking, CRM, HR/payroll & POS. Works with Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, Windsurf, Cline, Antigravity, Codex, Copilot, Gemini CLI — and any MCP-compatible client.

MCP-сервер для МойСклад (JSON API 1.2): остатки, товары, заказы, документы, отчёты и запись документов через safety-гейт. Schema-driven, мультикабинет, поиск по-русски. | MCP server for the MoySklad JSON API.
A provably read-only SQL layer for AI agents (MCP) and weekly reports — over the database behind an ERP (Logo Tiger, Netsis, Mikro). Statement-checking guard, measured against 28 attacks.
An AI business analyst for your Odoo ERP — one-call reports with verdicts, over MCP
Open-source, agent-first business software for Swiss SMEs: accounting, QR-bill, MWST, bank, stock, projects. Local-first, MCP server. Public beta.
